tools.name: wireframe_guide
tools.description: How to write a tsquare wireframe: the text format, the rules, a worked example and every component with its props. Call it once before writing your first wireframe.

tools.name: render_wireframe
tools.description: Check tsquare wireframe text and render it. Returns a PNG of the board so you can see it, or the problems by line number (with the valid options) if the text isn't valid. Fix every problem and call it again.

tools.name: share_wireframe
tools.description: Links for valid tsquare wireframe text, the same kinds as the playground's Copy link menu: a share link to edit it in the playground, image links (SVG, PNG), Markdown and HTML. Ask only for the links the user needs (default: an SVG image link and the share link). Each link contains the whole wirefra

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: share_wireframe · Public sink: share_wireframe · Destructive: wireframe_guide.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: share_wireframe · Public sink: share_wireframe · Destructive: wireframe_guide

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
